items.evidence: Reservoir slot 1 and plate slot 2 loaded with the required labels; p20 left and p300 right with tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
Log shows 100 uL aspirated from reservoir A1 and dispensed into plate A1, then 100 uL aspirated from reservoir A1 and dispensed into plate B1, using the p300 only.
Each aspirate/dispense is preceded by a pick up tip and followed by a drop tip. No tip is held at the end.
100 uL is within the p300 range, apiLevel 2.15 is valid, and the simulation passed. The blow_out is at the top of the destination well and is safe.
The protocol performs exactly the requested split of 100 uL into each of A1 and B1. Comments and metadata match what the code does.

judge.summary: The protocol transfers 100 µL from reservoir A1 to plate A1 and then to plate B1 with the p300, using a fresh tip for each, as the run log confirms. Deck setup, tip handling and API level are all valid, and no extra wells are touched.
